coverage_note: Official winners page read in full (third edition, 27 Nov 2025, 45 awards in 23 categories). Each category has a BEST (critics/panel) and FAVOURITE (public vote) winner; one entry per venue with all its wins in note. Regional categories (AlUla, Al Khobar/Eastern Region, Red Sea, Jeddah) dropped. Shortlists for these years are no longer online. Paywall: no.
